questions.stem_text: A car is rolling on a level street. What can make the car stop moving?

options.A: a force that pushes straight up
options.B: a force that pushes straight down
options.C: a force that pushes the same direction that the car is moving
options.D: a force that pushes the opposite of the direction that the car is moving

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - a force that pushes the opposite of the direction that the car is moving

questions.stem_text:
The human body produces motion by changing chemical energy into mechanical energy. Which
of these best describes what happens to the energy?

options.A: The total amount of energy increases.
options.B: The total amount of energy is constant.
options.C: The energy is destroyed through motion.
options.D: The amount of chemical energy increases.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - The total amount of energy is constant.
